title: Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
author: Li Li, Xiangbo Gao, Bo Ni, Samyadeep Basu et al.
description: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion. We study this failure, termed motion collapse, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits. On VE-Bench, the evaluated composite reward prefers a motion-suppressed candidate in 97% of cases.…
summary: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion. We study this failure, termed motion collapse, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits.
takeaways: A distillation anchor preserves alignment with human quality judgments.
We study this failure, termed motion collapse, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits.
On VE-Bench, the evaluated composite reward prefers a motion-suppressed candidate in 97% of cases.
